summary: Frontend-only verification of LiveOverlays (incoming-call RING + new-alert toast). All 3 requested behaviors PASS. Ring overlay appeared within ~1s of POST /api/public/qr/{id}/call/start with correct title 'Someone needs to reach you', plate 'TSF714F3', and Decline/Accept buttons. Decline dismissed the overlay and it did NOT re-appear for the same call over the next 7s of polling. New-alert toast '🔔 New wrong parking on TSF714F3' appeared after triggering /api/public/qr/{id}/incident. App boots, demo login works, and (tabs) render without crash from the always-mounted LiveOverlays poller.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveOverlays.tsx uses useNativeDriver: true on Animated but web preview logs 'RCTAnimation module missing, falling back to JS-based animation' — cosmetic only; no user-visible issue.

Alert primer resets only on user change; if the same session is kept open for hours without polling, memory footprint of knownAlerts Set will grow unboundedly. Not blocking, but consider capping size or trimming.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test triggered one masked-call (fd3a3c61-...) and one incident (99632d3c-...) via public unauthenticated endpoints against demo QR 17cc2084-117a-439f-b3d1-273479b64f11.
